statement: Harness frozen after the self-test and before the first scored execution. Scored runs refuse to start if the matrix hash differs. A later harness defect is recorded in the defect register and the harness is versioned (v2); v1 results are kept.
pre_registered_supplementary: SUPP-H5-BEFORE: run the 63 sealed H5 rows (unmodified, read-only) through the Case-turn entry in both snapshots to measure BEFORE detection on the same rows; reported as supplementary, never as part of the 72 executions and never as independent validation
selftest_note: The self-test journey outputs in 03-results/selftest were produced before the interpretation register and the J03/J06/J08/verdict patches; they are retained as the evidence that motivated I1-I3.

amendments.change: diag-support.ts: optional KAWA_DIAG_PLAYBOOK_FLAGS=on sets KAEL_PLAYBOOK_<SERVICE>_ENABLED=true for the six services. Default behaviour is byte-identical (flag unset), so the scored v1 runs are unaffected. Added after the scored runs for the pre-declared sensitivity SUPP-FLAGS (BEFORE and AFTER with every playbook flag on). The v1 file hash used by the scored runs is recorded in logs/commands.jsonl.
